title: Triton Optimizer Multi-Agent Round Result
description: Output produced by a Per-Round Worker sub CLI after completing Phase 0-8.

algorithm.description: Optimization algorithm used for this round

best_speedup.description: Best geometric-mean speedup achieved in this round

improvement_made.description: Whether Phase 4 produced a speedup improvement

optimized.description: Whether the final code came from Phase 4 optimization

effective_metric_source.description: Performance metric source for this round

work_dir.description: Path to the round work directory

direction_yield.description: Causal quality label for the direction executed in this round

absolute_gain_vs_baseline.description: best_speedup minus the baseline speedup this round started from

baseline_dir.description: round_dir of the baseline code used for this round

error.description: Error message if status is failed

design_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the design rationale and algorithm sketch for this round

iter_count.description: Number of coding/verification iterations performed in this round

opt_iter_count.description: Number of optimization iterations performed in Phase 4 of this round

key_fixes.description: List of key fixes or workarounds applied during this round

bottlenecks_observed.description: List of observed performance or compile bottlenecks during this round

parent_round_journal.description: Path to the parent round's detailed journal (round_journal.md)
